Boundary: Price adapters, signals and momentum availability policy; no historical membership or delisting service.
Ranks, filters, Top-N and group operations use supplied classifications; group selection does not guarantee neutral exposure.
Equal, positive-signal, rank and inverse-volatility modes have distinct input and normalisation rules.
Default down-only scaling adds cash; no borrowing or margin engine follows from removing the scaling cap.
Clustering and recursive allocation depend on the covariance sample and lookback.
Iterative updates provide no robust long-only or convergence guarantee.
The max_div branch is inverse-volatility weighting and ignores correlations; global minimum-variance optimisation is not supplied.
Position counts differ from weight caps; upward normalisation can undo caps.
Binary filtering and configured regime weights are supplied; fractional selection scaling need not survive normalisation.
Whole shares, cash-constrained purchases and residual cash; unsupported targets are not comprehensively rejected.
Residual cash earns zero; no borrowing, margin or complete short-sale accounting.
run_backtest() is gross; pt_collect_results() applies target-weight turnover deductions. No integrated fees, slippage or impact.
Metric conventions differ by reporter. Parameter search supplies no built-in multiple-testing correction or performance-decay model.
Tabular ridge, RF and XGBoost use optional packages. Sequence models require usable Keras; the factory announces linear fallback and exposes the actual type.
Input prediction rows can become allocation opportunities; model step and forecast horizon do not define holdings.
A unified layer across TradeTesterR and PortfolioTesteR is not an implemented integration.
